# Krool World UI: settings window text, generated from the code by tools/SettingsDoc on every build.
# Do not edit: change the config.Bind text instead. Translate into <Language>.settings.txt with the same keys.
# Keep setting names short (they sit in a fixed-width column); descriptions can be a sentence or two.

# General
sec_General = General
s_General_SettingsKey = Settings Key
s_General_SettingsKey_d = Opens this window. On a controller, use Krool World UI in the pause menu.
s_General_WindowScale = Window Scale
s_General_WindowScale_d = Size of this window. It also follows the game's GUI scale.
s_General_HideKey = Hide Key
s_General_HideKey_d = Hides everything this mod draws until pressed again. Unset by default.
s_General_Volume = Volume
s_General_Volume_d = Volume of all the mod's sounds, on top of each feature's own volume. 0 mutes them.
s_General_ColorblindFriendly = Colorblind Friendly
s_General_ColorblindFriendly_d = Warning colors that stay distinct with red-green color blindness: orange-red and pink instead of orange and red, sky blue instead of green.

# Skill XP Bars
sec_SkillXPBars = Skill XP Bars
s_SkillXPBars_Enabled = Enabled
s_SkillXPBars_Enabled_d = Show a skill on the HUD while you gain XP in it.
s_SkillXPBars_Style = Style
s_SkillXPBars_Style_d = Tiles: the skill icon over its XP bar, side by side. Rows: a wide bar with the icon at the left, stacked.
enum_SkillXpBarsBarStyle_Tiles = Tiles
enum_SkillXpBarsBarStyle_Rows = Rows
s_SkillXPBars_MaxBars = Max Bars
s_SkillXPBars_MaxBars_d = Most skills shown at once, fewer if they do not fit. Past this the oldest is replaced.
s_SkillXPBars_HiddenSkills = Hidden Skills
s_SkillXPBars_HiddenSkills_d = Skills never shown, separated by commas: Run, Jump, Sneak. Names as the game shows them, or English names, which work in every language.
grp_Tiles = Tiles
s_SkillXPBars_TileSize = Tile Size
s_SkillXPBars_TileSize_d = Tile width in HUD pixels. A tile is a third taller than wide.
s_SkillXPBars_TileSize_w = Used when Style is Tiles.
s_SkillXPBars_TileLevel = Tile Level
s_SkillXPBars_TileLevel_d = The skill level in the tile's corner.
s_SkillXPBars_TileLevel_w = Used when Style is Tiles.
grp_Rows = Rows
s_SkillXPBars_Labels = Labels
s_SkillXPBars_Labels_d = Name And Level: the skill name and level on the bar. Icon Only: just the icon and bar.
s_SkillXPBars_Labels_w = Used when Style is Rows.
enum_SkillXpBarsLabelStyle_NameAndLevel = Name And Level
enum_SkillXpBarsLabelStyle_IconOnly = Icon Only
s_SkillXPBars_ShowGainText = Show Gain Text
s_SkillXPBars_ShowGainText_d = The XP gained since the bar appeared, as a percent of a level.
s_SkillXPBars_ShowGainText_w = Used when Style is Rows and Labels is Name And Level.
s_SkillXPBars_BarWidth = Bar Width
s_SkillXPBars_BarWidth_d = Row width in HUD pixels.
s_SkillXPBars_BarWidth_w = Used when Style is Rows.
s_SkillXPBars_BarHeight = Bar Height
s_SkillXPBars_BarHeight_d = Row height in HUD pixels.
s_SkillXPBars_BarHeight_w = Used when Style is Rows.
grp_Look = Look
s_SkillXPBars_BarColor = Bar Color
s_SkillXPBars_BarColor_d = Bar color. XP you had shows darker, new XP lighter.
s_SkillXPBars_Opacity = Opacity
s_SkillXPBars_Opacity_d = 1 is solid; lower shows the game through it.
s_SkillXPBars_HoldSeconds = Hold Seconds
s_SkillXPBars_HoldSeconds_d = Seconds a skill stays after its last XP.
s_SkillXPBars_FadeSeconds = Fade Seconds
s_SkillXPBars_FadeSeconds_d = Seconds the fade-out takes.
grp_Floatingtext = Floating text
s_SkillXPBars_FloatingText = Floating Text
s_SkillXPBars_FloatingText_d = XP over your character, like a damage number. Only you see it. Every Gain, Level Up Only, or Off.
enum_SkillXpBarsFloatMode_Off = Off
enum_SkillXpBarsFloatMode_EveryGain = Every Gain
enum_SkillXpBarsFloatMode_LevelUpOnly = Level Up Only
s_SkillXPBars_FloatingTextColor = Floating Text Color
s_SkillXPBars_FloatingTextColor_d = Color of the floating XP text.
s_SkillXPBars_FloatingTextColor_w = Used when Floating Text is not Off.
grp_Placement = Placement
s_SkillXPBars_Placement = Placement
s_SkillXPBars_Placement_d = Bottom Right: above the key hints. Below Stamina: under the stamina bar. Right Side: below the minimap. Custom: at Anchor X and Anchor Y.
enum_SkillXpBarsPlacement_BottomRight = Bottom Right
enum_SkillXpBarsPlacement_BelowStamina = Below Stamina
enum_SkillXpBarsPlacement_RightSide = Right Side
enum_SkillXpBarsPlacement_Custom = Custom
s_SkillXPBars_AnchorX = Anchor X
s_SkillXPBars_AnchorX_d = Center. 0 is the left of the screen, 1 the right.
s_SkillXPBars_AnchorX_w = Used when Placement is Custom.
s_SkillXPBars_AnchorY = Anchor Y
s_SkillXPBars_AnchorY_d = Top edge. 0 is the bottom of the screen, 1 the top.
s_SkillXPBars_AnchorY_w = Used when Placement is Custom.
s_SkillXPBars_OffsetX = Offset X
s_SkillXPBars_OffsetX_d = Move left (-) or right (+), in HUD pixels.
s_SkillXPBars_OffsetY = Offset Y
s_SkillXPBars_OffsetY_d = Move down (-) or up (+), in HUD pixels.

# Weight
sec_Weight = Weight
s_Weight_Enabled = Enabled
s_Weight_Enabled_d = Your carry weight as a bar left of the food icons.
s_Weight_Show = Show
s_Weight_Show_d = Always: always on screen. Near Limit: at or past Near Limit Percent. When Changed: for a few seconds after your weight changes.
enum_WeightDisplayShowMode_Always = Always
enum_WeightDisplayShowMode_NearLimit = Near Limit
enum_WeightDisplayShowMode_WhenChanged = When Changed
s_Weight_NearLimitPercent = Near Limit Percent
s_Weight_NearLimitPercent_d = Percent of your max weight where the bar turns the near-limit color, and where Near Limit shows it.
s_Weight_ChangedSeconds = Changed Seconds
s_Weight_ChangedSeconds_d = Seconds the bar stays after your weight changes.
s_Weight_ChangedSeconds_w = Used when Show is When Changed.
grp_Colors = Colors
s_Weight_Colors = Colors
s_Weight_Colors_d = Thresholds: fill color, then near-limit past Near Limit Percent, then over when overweight. Gradient: blends through the three. Single: always the fill color.
enum_WeightDisplayColorMode_Thresholds = Thresholds
enum_WeightDisplayColorMode_Gradient = Gradient
enum_WeightDisplayColorMode_Single = Single
s_Weight_FillColor = Fill Color
s_Weight_FillColor_d = Bar color under the limit.
s_Weight_NearLimitColor = Near Limit Color
s_Weight_NearLimitColor_d = Bar color near the limit.
s_Weight_NearLimitColor_w = Used when Colors is not Single.
s_Weight_OverColor = Over Color
s_Weight_OverColor_d = Bar color when overweight. It also flashes.
s_Weight_OverColor_w = Used when Colors is not Single.
grp_Text = Text
s_Weight_Text = Text
s_Weight_Text_d = Numbers above the bar: weight over max, weight only, percent, or none.
enum_WeightDisplayTextMode_CurrentAndMax = Current And Max
enum_WeightDisplayTextMode_Current = Current
enum_WeightDisplayTextMode_Percent = Percent
enum_WeightDisplayTextMode_None = None
s_Weight_TextSize = Text Size
s_Weight_TextSize_d = Font size of the numbers.
s_Weight_TextSize_w = Used when Text is not None.
grp_Size = Size
s_Weight_BarLength = Bar Length
s_Weight_BarLength_d = Bar length in HUD pixels at the normal 300 max weight.
s_Weight_BarThickness = Bar Thickness
s_Weight_BarThickness_d = Bar thickness in HUD pixels. The health bar is 32.
s_Weight_ScaleWithMaxWeight = Scale With Max Weight
s_Weight_ScaleWithMaxWeight_d = Grow the bar with your max weight: a Megingjord (+150) makes it half again as long.
s_Weight_Opacity = Opacity
s_Weight_Opacity_d = 1 is solid; lower shows the game through it.
s_Weight_OffsetX = Offset X
s_Weight_OffsetX_d = Move left (-) or right (+), in HUD pixels.
s_Weight_OffsetY = Offset Y
s_Weight_OffsetY_d = Move down (-) or up (+), in HUD pixels.

# Food Decay
sec_FoodDecay = Food Decay
s_FoodDecay_Enabled = Enabled
s_FoodDecay_Enabled_d = A faint segment past the end of the health, stamina and eitr bars: the max your food has lost as it wears off, which fresh food would give back.
s_FoodDecay_Health = Health
s_FoodDecay_Health_d = Segment on the health bar.
s_FoodDecay_HealthColor = Health Color
s_FoodDecay_HealthColor_d = Color of the health segment.
s_FoodDecay_HealthColor_w = Used when Health is on.
s_FoodDecay_Stamina = Stamina
s_FoodDecay_Stamina_d = Segment on the stamina bar. Like the bar, it shows while stamina is not full.
s_FoodDecay_StaminaColor = Stamina Color
s_FoodDecay_StaminaColor_d = Color of the stamina segment.
s_FoodDecay_StaminaColor_w = Used when Stamina is on.
s_FoodDecay_Eitr = Eitr
s_FoodDecay_Eitr_d = Segment on the eitr bar, for eitr foods. Like the bar, it shows while eitr is not full.
s_FoodDecay_EitrColor = Eitr Color
s_FoodDecay_EitrColor_d = Color of the eitr segment.
s_FoodDecay_EitrColor_w = Used when Eitr is on.

# Food Reminder
sec_FoodReminder = Food Reminder
s_FoodReminder_Enabled = Enabled
s_FoodReminder_Enabled_d = Food reminders in a small box at the top of the screen.
grp_Reminders = Reminders
s_FoodReminder_RunningOut = Running Out
s_FoodReminder_RunningOut_d = Remind when a food is about to run out.
s_FoodReminder_ThresholdMinutes = Threshold Minutes
s_FoodReminder_ThresholdMinutes_d = Remind when a food has this many minutes left.
s_FoodReminder_ThresholdMinutes_w = Used when Running Out is on.
s_FoodReminder_FinalMinute = Final Minute
s_FoodReminder_FinalMinute_d = A second reminder with one minute left.
s_FoodReminder_FinalMinute_w = Used when Running Out is on.
s_FoodReminder_CanEatAgain = Can Eat Again
s_FoodReminder_CanEatAgain_d = Remind when a food can be eaten again, half way through its time.
s_FoodReminder_ShowSeconds = Show Seconds
s_FoodReminder_ShowSeconds_d = Seconds a reminder stays on screen.
s_FoodReminder_ShowSeconds_w = Used when Running Out or Can Eat Again is on.
grp_Nofood = No food
s_FoodReminder_NoFoodMessage = No Food Message
s_FoodReminder_NoFoodMessage_d = Keep a message up while you have no food, until you eat or dismiss it. Also after you respawn.
s_FoodReminder_NoFoodWhen = No Food When
s_FoodReminder_NoFoodWhen_d = No Food: when all your food is gone. Any Slot Empty: whenever a food slot is free.
s_FoodReminder_NoFoodWhen_w = Used when No Food Message is on.
enum_FoodCalloutEmptyWhen_NoFood = No Food
enum_FoodCalloutEmptyWhen_AnySlotEmpty = Any Slot Empty
s_FoodReminder_DismissKey = Dismiss Key
s_FoodReminder_DismissKey_d = Hides the no-food message until you next eat.
s_FoodReminder_DismissKey_w = Used when No Food Message is on.
s_FoodReminder_DismissButton = Dismiss Button
s_FoodReminder_DismissButton_d = Controller button that hides the no-food message. Each also does something in the game (map, run, crouch), so pick the one you use least.
s_FoodReminder_DismissButton_w = Used when No Food Message is on.
enum_FoodCalloutPadButton_None = None
enum_FoodCalloutPadButton_LeftStickClick = Left Stick Click
enum_FoodCalloutPadButton_RightStickClick = Right Stick Click
enum_FoodCalloutPadButton_Back = Back
grp_Sound = Sound
s_FoodReminder_Sound = Sound
s_FoodReminder_Sound_d = A soft chime with each reminder.
s_FoodReminder_SoundVolume = Sound Volume
s_FoodReminder_SoundVolume_d = Chime volume, on top of the game's own volume.
s_FoodReminder_SoundVolume_w = Used when Sound is on.
s_FoodReminder_Size = Size
s_FoodReminder_Size_d = 1 is the normal size.
s_FoodReminder_Opacity = Opacity
s_FoodReminder_Opacity_d = 1 is solid; lower shows the game through it.
s_FoodReminder_AnchorX = Anchor X
s_FoodReminder_AnchorX_d = Center of the box. 0 is the left of the screen, 1 the right.
s_FoodReminder_AnchorY = Anchor Y
s_FoodReminder_AnchorY_d = Top of the box. 0 is the bottom of the screen, 1 the top. Moves down by itself to clear the raid banner.

# Crafting
sec_Crafting = Crafting
s_Crafting_Enabled = Enabled
s_Crafting_Enabled_d = Category tabs and a sort order for the crafting list at every station.
s_Crafting_Categories = Categories
s_Crafting_Categories_d = A row of tabs above the list: weapons, armor, tools, ammo, food, materials. On a controller, the D-pad left and right switch tabs.
s_Crafting_Sort = Sort
s_Crafting_Sort_d = Default: the game's order. Name: A to Z. Type: grouped like the tabs. Station Level: newest unlocks first.
enum_CraftingTabsSortOrder_Default = Default
enum_CraftingTabsSortOrder_Name = Name
enum_CraftingTabsSortOrder_Type = Type
enum_CraftingTabsSortOrder_StationLevel = Station Level

s_Crafting_CraftableFirst_d = List what you can craft right now at the top.
s_Crafting_CraftableFirst_w = Used when Sort is not Default.
s_Crafting_SortButton = Sort Button
s_Crafting_SortButton_d = A button under the list that changes the sort order. Right-click goes back.

# Compass
sec_Compass = Compass
s_Compass_Enabled = Enabled
s_Compass_Enabled_d = A compass strip at the top of the screen: your heading, friends and nearby map pins.
grp_Readout = Readout
s_Compass_Heading = Heading
s_Compass_Heading_d = Your heading under the center mark, for call-outs. 0 is north, 90 east.
s_Compass_HeadingDirection = Heading Direction
s_Compass_HeadingDirection_d = Add the direction after the number: 212 SW.
s_Compass_HeadingDirection_w = Used when Heading is on.
s_Compass_FocusInfo = Focus Info
s_Compass_FocusInfo_d = The name of the marker you look at, beside the heading.
s_Compass_Distance = Distance
s_Compass_Distance_d = Focused: the distance of the marker you look at. All Markers: a distance under every marker. Off: none.
enum_CompassDistanceMode_Focused = Focused
enum_CompassDistanceMode_AllMarkers = All Markers
enum_CompassDistanceMode_Off = Off
grp_Markers = Markers
s_Compass_Friends = Friends
s_Compass_Friends_d = Other players, each in their own color. Far-away players show if they share their position on the map.
s_Compass_FriendNames = Friend Names
s_Compass_FriendNames_d = Focused: a friend's name when you look at them. Always: under every friend. Off: none.
s_Compass_FriendNames_w = Used when Friends is on.
enum_CompassNameMode_Focused = Focused
enum_CompassNameMode_Always = Always
enum_CompassNameMode_Off = Off
s_Compass_Pings = Pings
s_Compass_Pings_d = Map pings from you and your friends, at any distance.
s_Compass_Pins = Pins
s_Compass_Pins_d = Pins you placed on the map, bench pins included.
s_Compass_Bed = Bed
s_Compass_Bed_d = Your bed.
s_Compass_Tombstone = Tombstone
s_Compass_Tombstone_d = Where you died.
s_Compass_Bosses = Bosses
s_Compass_Bosses_d = Boss altars and other boss locations on your map.
s_Compass_PinRange = Pin Range
s_Compass_PinRange_d = Pins farther than this, in meters, are left off. Friends and pings ignore it.
s_Compass_PinRange_w = Used when Pins, Bed, Tombstone or Bosses is on.
s_Compass_HeightArrowMeters = Height Arrow Meters
s_Compass_HeightArrowMeters_d = An up or down arrow on markers this many meters above or below you. 0 = off.
s_Compass_MaxMarkers = Max Markers
s_Compass_MaxMarkers_d = Most markers at once. Pings and friends first, then the nearest.
s_Compass_Size = Size
s_Compass_Size_d = Overall size. 1 is the normal size.
s_Compass_Width = Width
s_Compass_Width_d = Strip width in HUD pixels. Kept clear of the minimap on narrow screens.
s_Compass_FieldOfView = Field Of View
s_Compass_FieldOfView_d = Degrees the strip covers. Narrower is easier to read.
s_Compass_Opacity = Opacity
s_Compass_Opacity_d = 1 is solid; lower shows the game through it.
s_Compass_Animations = Animations
s_Compass_Animations_d = Markers ease in, grow when you look at them, and pings pulse. Off: plain fades.
s_Compass_OffsetX = Offset X
s_Compass_OffsetX_d = Move left (-) or right (+), in HUD pixels.
s_Compass_OffsetY = Offset Y
s_Compass_OffsetY_d = Move down (-) or up (+) from the top of the screen, in HUD pixels.

# Low Ammo
sec_LowAmmo = Low Ammo
s_LowAmmo_Enabled = Enabled
s_LowAmmo_Enabled_d = Warn when a shot leaves you low on arrows, bolts or bait.
s_LowAmmo_FirstWarning = First Warning
s_LowAmmo_FirstWarning_d = Warn when this many are left. 0 = off.
s_LowAmmo_SecondWarning = Second Warning
s_LowAmmo_SecondWarning_d = Warn again, in red, when this many are left. 0 = off.
s_LowAmmo_ShowSeconds = Show Seconds
s_LowAmmo_ShowSeconds_d = Seconds the warning stays on screen.
s_LowAmmo_Sound = Sound
s_LowAmmo_Sound_d = A short low tone with each warning.
s_LowAmmo_SoundVolume = Sound Volume
s_LowAmmo_SoundVolume_d = Tone volume, on top of the game's own volume.
s_LowAmmo_SoundVolume_w = Used when Sound is on.
s_LowAmmo_Size = Size
s_LowAmmo_Size_d = 1 is the normal size.
s_LowAmmo_Opacity = Opacity
s_LowAmmo_Opacity_d = 1 is solid; lower shows the game through it.
s_LowAmmo_AnchorX = Anchor X
s_LowAmmo_AnchorX_d = Center of the box. 0 is the left of the screen, 1 the right.
s_LowAmmo_AnchorY = Anchor Y
s_LowAmmo_AnchorY_d = Center of the box. 0 is the bottom of the screen, 1 the top.

# Bench Pins
sec_BenchPins = Bench Pins
s_BenchPins_Enabled = Enabled
s_BenchPins_Enabled_d = Add a map pin when you build a workbench, so you can find your camps again.
s_BenchPins_PinStations = Pin Stations
s_BenchPins_PinStations_d = Workbench Only, or every crafting station: forge, stonecutter, artisan table and the rest.
enum_BenchPinsStations_WorkbenchOnly = Workbench Only
enum_BenchPinsStations_AllCraftingStations = All Crafting Stations
s_BenchPins_SkipNearPinMeters = Skip Near Pin Meters
s_BenchPins_SkipNearPinMeters_d = No new pin if one of your pins is this close, in meters, so a base gets one pin. 0 = always pin.
s_BenchPins_RemoveWithBench = Remove With Bench
s_BenchPins_RemoveWithBench_d = Removing a bench with the hammer removes its pin, or moves it to another bench within Skip Near Pin Meters.
s_BenchPins_Announce = Announce
s_BenchPins_Announce_d = Show the new pin's name in the top-left messages.
grp_Pin = Pin
s_BenchPins_Icon = Icon
s_BenchPins_Icon_d = Map pin icon.
enum_BenchPinsPinIcon_Fire = Fire
enum_BenchPinsPinIcon_House = House
enum_BenchPinsPinIcon_Hammer = Hammer
enum_BenchPinsPinIcon_Dot = Dot
enum_BenchPinsPinIcon_Portal = Portal
s_BenchPins_Names = Names
s_BenchPins_Names_d = Random Name: a Norse-sounding name from the lists below. Station Name: "Workbench". No Name: just the icon.
enum_BenchPinsNaming_RandomName = Random Name
enum_BenchPinsNaming_StationName = Station Name
enum_BenchPinsNaming_NoName = No Name
s_BenchPins_NamePrefixes = Name Prefixes
s_BenchPins_NamePrefixes_d = First halves of random names, separated by commas.
s_BenchPins_NamePrefixes_w = Used when Names is Random Name.
s_BenchPins_NameSuffixes = Name Suffixes
s_BenchPins_NameSuffixes_d = Second halves of random names, separated by commas.
s_BenchPins_NameSuffixes_w = Used when Names is Random Name.

# Auto Repair
sec_AutoRepair = Auto Repair
s_AutoRepair_Enabled = Enabled
s_AutoRepair_Enabled_d = Opening a crafting station repairs every item it can, as if you pressed its repair button for each.
s_AutoRepair_EquippedOnly = Equipped Only
s_AutoRepair_EquippedOnly_d = Repair only what you are wearing and holding, not spare gear in your bags.
s_AutoRepair_Announce = Announce
s_AutoRepair_Announce_d = Say how many items were repaired, in the middle of the screen.
